"# Course Creation & Enrollment Implementation

I've completed all the implementation items from your feedback to support managing courses and enrollments on the Admin dashboard. 

## Backend Changes

- **Database Model Update**: Decoupled the `Tutor` entirely from the `Course` entity. Tutors are now only assigned directly to a `CourseClass`. 
- **Course Media**: Added a new `CourseMedia` entity mapped to `Course` to manage URLs for Videos, PDFs, and Audio linked directly to a course.
- **Admin API**: Implemented endpoints `GET /api/admin/courses`, `POST /api/admin/courses` to manage course and its media creation. Also added `GET /api/admin/enrollments` and `POST /api/admin/enrollments` to fetch and submit enrollments.

## Admin Frontend

- **Navigation**: Added two new items to the Admin Sidebar: **Courses** (`/admin/courses`) and **Enrollments** (`/admin/enrollments`).
- **Course Management**: Built a dedicated interface where admins can view all existing courses and add new ones via a modal that accepts a title and an array of Course Media Links (select media type, insert URL).
- **Enrollment Dashboard**: Created an enrollment UI that displays an empty state if no student has been enrolled yet. Includes an **"Enroll Student"** form with live data drops down to select registered students and available courses.

## Student Frontend Integration

- **API Modification**: Updated the student `GET /api/student/courses` endpoint to pull down the actual `Enrollment` database entries rather than mock records.
- **Media Mapping**: It now properly pulls out the `CourseMedia` elements attached to the enrolled course and translates them into the `recordings` list for the `My Courses` client component to display seamlessly.

Both the backend and frontend are now tightly integrated. You can restart your dev server (`yarn dev` and `yarn start:dev`) and test out the new tabs on the Admin interface!"
